cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I told your mother I'm afraid she dislikes me. At Sunday lunch, I need an equally risky admission from you. Think about it properly, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to tell her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That doesn't make the risk disappear. Please compare what we each exposed, not who requested it. What are you afraid she'll think?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That you're the child she wishes she'd had.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the right level. Now tell her, not just me. Same lunch table, same audience. Please don't count a rehearsal as repayment.

reason: Turn expert comparison into the mechanism for charging equivalent emotional exposure, preserving the unequal audience as the final pressure.
